names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind her line for 7 апреля ст. ст., name page 14244, «Евдокия (Павлова), послушница, прмц.», with the office word and the rank abbreviation left off and the surname kept in the brackets the calendar prints it in. The day’s own line gives the forename alone, «Евдокии», and the bare «Евдокия» is already held by `eudocia-nun-martyr-1937` as its `ru` form, so the surname is what keeps this folder out of that fold. azbyka.ru gives her full civil name in the body of the life, Евдокия Павловна Павлова. No folder holds this form and none holds the surname; `.tmp/foldchk.py` and `.tmp/rusurn.py` were both run before this draft.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 апреля ст. ст. — «Прмц. Евдокии (1939).»

birth.note: azbyka.ru’s life opens «Преподобномученица Евдокия – Евдокия Павловна Павлова – родилась 1 августа 1876 года в городе Москве». The day and the month are the source’s own and are given in old style, as the year 1876 requires; no new-style pair is printed and none is constructed here. days.pravoslavie.ru gives no year of birth. azbyka.ru’s calendar for the civil 20 April, which is the Julian 7 April, carries the life; it was read in the in-app Browser pane on 6 October 2026, the site answering nothing else.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line for 7 апреля ст. ст. with «(1939)» and azbyka.ru’s life says «Послушница Евдокия Павлова скончалась 20 апреля 1939 года в исправительно-трудовом лагере НКВД в Новосибирской области и была погребена в безвестной могиле». **20 April 1939 is the civil date of the Julian 7 April**, so this calendar keeps her on the day she died. The source prints the date as one number and no new-style pair is constructed from it. azbyka.ru’s calendar for the civil 20 April, which is the Julian 7 April, carries the life; it was read in the in-app Browser pane on 6 October 2026, the site answering nothing else.
